why: Measure a real mixed-building maximum-sized creation and avoid rebuilding unchanged land reports and pixels for funds/title/description edits.
fixture: 256 completed buildings across 21 inland types; 12 unique custom residents, mixed hats; generated Mata Atlantica seed 42; no authored routes or stocked livestock. Validated through normal scenario compilation.
baseline: Fixed 2374fde editor/index.js served over current shared modules; fresh browser with artwork ready.
checks: Native reports remain byte-identical when only title, description or funds change
Actual UI avoids land queries/repaint for funds edits; seed edits refresh reports and repaint
Invalid-title repair and undo from invalid geography restore valid previews
Core creator save/reload/test/restart/return flow preserves normal saves
visual: Inspected fully rendered mixed-fixture editor capture. Initial captures made while artwork loaded were rejected as performance evidence; benchmark now waits for aria-busy=false.
limits: Synchronous handler timings and two-frame presentation samples, not full sustained camera/brush/save/compile cancellation/GPU/simulation release gates. Performance is observed on this host, not a device guarantee.
